conclusions: Public Agent-facing surfaces should expose durable responsibilities and semantic intent, while workload-specific mechanics remain explicit local modules.
Harness is conditional cognition packaging and should be caller-neutral by default; Host Task authority is an optional integration, not a prerequisite for every Run.
Runtime is already close to the desired Agent-first boundary because reliable physical execution authority is future-model robust and largely classical.
Observation is a projection pattern, not a new fact owner or automatically justified product plane.

nextStep.rule: Use measured Agent burden to test semantic action lowering, compact inspect projections and minimal operational working state before Prime, TCG or generic multi-Agent construction.

changes: ordivon_harness.api is the recommended Host-free application facade
ordivon_harness.core remains the wider Host-free integration facade
former Host-backed application facade is explicit as ordivon_harness.host_api
historical package-root aliases remain lazy during the pre-1.0 window
harness.reason: Caller-neutral Run authority, independent Journal/CAS, standalone execution and Host-free Runtime bridging already existed; the old Host-backed Runner remained the recommended API only because of historical packaging.

changes: removed workload-specific classes from package-root exports
kept all workload implementations under ordivon_host.engine
migrated five canonical live scripts to explicit engine imports
host.reason: Durable Task/work authority, consequence/completion, recovery and foreign-executor binding remain Host responsibilities; repository read, mutation and code-change classes are proven workload implementations rather than Host primitives.

observation.reason: B3 already proves the needed pattern with run-once read-only owner exporters, an in-process derived Gateway and frozen selection while product authority stays with owners; recurring production consumers have not justified daemon, follow service, central shadow database or repository extraction.

runtime.reason: Workspace/Job/Attempt/Artifact truth, idempotent admission, explicit UNKNOWN, cancellation, durable Patch identity, reconciliation and read-only inspection are already correctly placed at the physical execution owner and mostly implemented with classical mechanisms.

purpose: Audit current Host, Harness, Runtime and Observation packaging against future-model-robust responsibilities, actual consumers, recovery boundaries and existing classical ownership.
